chunks: Do you not see how God has fashioned seven skies one above the other,

key_terms.طِبَاقًا: layer upon layer / one above the other

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the structure of the seven heavens?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Tawhid* in creation, where the 'layers' (tibaqan) signify both the physical structure of the cosmos and the hierarchical spiritual realms (*alam al-mala'ika*). Scholars like Allamah Tabatabai emphasize that this orderly creation serves as a rational proof for the One Creator, inviting the disbelievers of Noah's time to observe the macrocosm as a sign of divine unity and power.
